raw.title: Muhammad Iqbal
raw.extract: Sir Muhammad Iqbal was an Islamic philosopher and poet. He is regarded as one of the most influential Urdu poets of the 20th century and his vision of a cultural and political ideal for the Muslims of British India is widely regarded as having animated the impulse behind the Pakistan Movement. The honorific commonly refers to him as Allama and is widely considered one of the most important and influential Muslim thinkers and Islamic religious philosophers of the 20th century.
